results.prompt: Summarise the plot of Hamlet in one sentence.
results.text: Hamlet, a prince of Denmark, is haunted by the ghost of his father, who claims to have been murdered by his uncle, Claudius, who has usurped the throne and married Hamlet's mother. Desperate to avenge his father's death, Hamlet sets out to investigate the murder and expose Claudius's crimes, but his indecision and philosophical doubts delay his revenge, leading to a tragic confrontation with the king and his own eventual demise.
